entities.summary: Julie Murphy is the #1 New York Times bestselling author of the books Side Effects May Vary (2014), Dumplin' (2015), Ramona Blue (2017), and Puddin' (2018). Murphy wrote her first novel, Side Effects May Vary, during National Novel Writing Month.
